prod-floor-marigold-clusters.notes: Brass pot renders black, and the floral crown is too narrow and sparse with overly exposed straight stems. Increase floral density and width, improve orange/yellow colour separation, and restore a convincing brass material.

prod-sign-mirror-welcome.notes: Mirror face appears as a nearly black panel instead of reflective mirror material. Frame details and supports are too dark, while the gold text is dim and may be unreadable on mobile. Brighten and rebalance the materials and improve text contrast.
